customer_facts.statement: Owner reports that two technicians sometimes attend one school.

hypotheses.claim: Assignments may be duplicated across contact channels.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Two workers may be intentional, or may serve different assets.

questions: On the latest occurrence, were they working on the same device and fault, and was a second worker intentionally requested?
Were both assignments visible before either person left?

recommendations.action: Review a small sample of allegedly duplicated visits with device and assignment records.
recommendations.condition: Investigation only; deduplication is not yet justified.
recommendations.human_review: Coordinator adjudicates the purpose of both visits.
acceptance_criteria: Each sampled visit is classified as intentional, unnecessary or unresolved with evidence.

unknowns: Frequency and avoidable cost of true duplicates
